title: Our dynamism is our power
slide_intent: Introduce a toolkit by showing its elements working together. The opening image gives the reader a visual example before the components are described separately.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can connect the energy of its visual devices to a concrete human-scale image.
demonstration: A close-up photograph shows an open hand holding a white object. Large type on green fields, a cyan loop and a pink arrow overlap the photograph.
practical_value: Judge the relationship between photography, type and graphic gestures on a composed example before selecting individual assets.

content_islands.name: Section rail and preface
content_islands.spec: Set the Brand assets navigation and introduction over the dark left side of the photograph.

content_islands.name: Photographic headline
content_islands.spec: Place the large stepped headline in the lower-right field. Keep the object in the palm visible above the headline and use drawn gestures to frame the words.
